title: Branch and Consolidate: A Unified Recipe for Multi-Teacher On-Policy Distillation
abstract: arXiv:2611.32515v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Specialists post-trained from a shared checkpoint acquire complementary capabilities, and multi-teacher on-policy distillation (MOPD) can consolidate them into a single model. However, we find that existing consolidation methods, from weight merging to MOPD, fall short when specialists diverge substantially from the shared checkpoint, whereas prior studies mostly examine specialists that remain close to it. We present a unified recipe for multimodal MOPD that consolidates such specialists back into the single student they branched from. The recipe specifies initialization, data selection, balanced supervision across teachers, and preservation of existing capabilities for consolidation, together with a targeted refinement stage for capabilities that still lag behind their specialists. In an industrial setting with six specialists, the student closely approaches each specialist in its own domain and surpasses the perception specialist. I

translated_title: 分支与整合：多教师在线策略蒸馏的统一配方
translated_abstract: 从共享检查点后训练得到的专家模型会习得互补的能力，而多教师在线策略蒸馏（MOPD）可以将这些能力整合到单一模型中。然而，我们发现现有的整合方法（从权重合并到MOPD）在专家模型与共享检查点产生显著偏离时效果不佳，而以往研究主要考察的是与检查点保持接近的专家模型。我们提出了一套用于多模态MOPD的统一配方，可将这些专家模型重新整合回它们最初分支出的那个单一学生模型中。该配方明确了整合所需的初始化、数据选择、跨教师的均衡监督以及现有能力的保持，并辅以针对性的精炼阶段，用于提升仍然落后于对应专家模型的能力。在一个包含六个专家模型的工业场景中，学生模型在每个专家模型自身的领域内均能接近其表现，并在感知领域超越了感知专家模型。
tldr: 该论文提出了一套统一的多模态多教师在线策略蒸馏配方，能够将大幅偏离共享检查点的专家模型重新整合回单一学生模型，使其在各个领域接近专家模型性能并超越感知专家。
en_tdlr: This paper presents a unified recipe for multi-teacher on-policy distillation that consolidates specialists diverging substantially from a shared checkpoint back into a single student model, which closely matches each specialist in its own domain and even surpasses the perception specialist.
